about_the_game:
SwooshMania is a fast-paced 3D time-trial racing game where precision, reflexes, and momentum are everything. Dash, jump, dodge, and transform through obstacle-packed tracks to chase the fastest time and climb the global leaderboard.

Key Features:

  • Feel the Rush – Experience tight, responsive controls and adrenaline-pumping action from start to finish.

  • Dynamic Hazards – Outsmart bouncing pillars, spike cubes, homing rockets, and crumbling platforms.

  • Global Leaderboards – Compete with players around the world. Every millisecond counts.

  • Minimal Look, Maximum Focus – Clean visuals keep your eyes on the track and your mind in the zone.

Think you’re the fastest?
Run. Dodge. Fly. Win.
Step into the world of SwooshMania and make your mark.
